what: The central idea: deferred config on a flextable
title: CLAUDE.md
text: clintable flextable extra x$clinify_config list attached. Every user-facing clin_*() builder verb almost nothing except mutate fields clinify_config return object. pagination, slicing, styling computed terminal action runs (print(), knit_print(), write_clindoc(), clindoc()). Understanding feature means tracing (1) config field clin_*() setter writes, (2) renderer reads . Key config fields: pagination_method ("default"/"custom"), page_by, max_rows, group_by, caption_by, group_when, key_cols, col_groups, auto_page_var, titles, footnotes, footnote_page, computed pagination_idx.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: prep_pagination_() render-time driver. produces pagination_idx: list pages, list(rows, cols, label, captions), via make_ind_list(). combines: - Row vectors (page_vecs): page_by_() splits page variable changes (group starts); max_rows_() splits every N rows respecting group boundaries. - Column vectors (col_vecs): alt_pages_() “alternating pages” (repeat key_cols page, append one col_group per page) — wide tables split across pages; otherwise columns. - Group labels captions carried forward across rows zoo::na.locf. clin_auto_page() separate pagination strategy: instead pre-slicing, flags rows flextable’s keep_with_next() Word avoids breaking groups across pages (auto_page_()).

code: clinify_table_default <- function(x, ...) {   # Clear all borders first and apply them just for the header   # (as horizontal lines).   x <- flextable::border_remove(x)   x <- flextable::hline(     x,     part = "header",     border = officer::fp_border()   )   # Top horizontal line for the table header.   x <- flextable::hline_top(x, part = "header")   x <- flextable::hline(x, part = "header", border = officer::fp_border())    # Remove blank bottoms   blk_inds <- which(     mapply(trimws, x$header$dataset) == "",     arr.ind = TRUE   )   # Want to ignore bottom row   blk_inds <- blk_inds[     blk_inds[, "row"] < nrow(x$header$dataset),     ,     drop = FALSE   ]    if (nrow(blk_inds) > 0) {     # Loop all except very bottom row     for (i in 1:nrow(blk_inds)) {       x <- flextable::hline(         x,         i = blk_inds[i, "row"],         j = blk_inds[i, "col"],         part = "header",         border = officer::fp_border(style = "none", width = 0)       )     }   }   # Bottom border   x <- flextable::hline_bottom(x, part = "header")    # Set font properties for the table header.   x <- flextable::font(x, part = "all", fontname = "Courier New")    # Set fontsize for both table header and table body.   x <- flextable::fontsize(x, part = "all", size = 9)    # Set table's layout.   # Fix the layout without discarding the rest of the table's properties.   # set_table_properties() rebuilds them all, which would reset the table's   # alignment on the page and the Word accessibility fields.   x$properties$layout <- "fixed"    x }
